A code window with a file name:

```{.r filename="analysis.R"}
fit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ arm, data = adsl)
summary(fit)
```

A code window with the label of its language:

```python
print("Hello from Python")
```

A highlighted code block with no window:

```{.r code-window-enabled="false"}
n_subjects <- nrow(adsl)
```
